name: Berrocal (Spain)
description: Vertical tricolour of green, blue and red with a broad blue stripe, charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Berrocal (a tree and a hermit on blue).
history: Municipal flag of Berrocal; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.

features.role: Berrocal arms — tree and hermit on blue
